title: Day Smokey Eye | 5 Steps | Makeup Tutorial
description:
Helllo makeup friends! I'm back with another makeup lesson here is a 5 step smokey eye, super easy and suitable for day time! 
↓ READ THIS ↓ 

Need to be ready in a hurry check out this video:
here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xr9Wuhwqk6E

Go from Basic to Glam in 5 steps check out this video: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f4toMzKlGho

Step 1 Prime Eyelid 
What I used: TheBalm Eyelid Primer
Brush : E40 http://www.blankcanvascosmetics.com/products/e40-41-double-ended-tapered-crease-blender-smudger.html

Step 2 Matte Medium Eyeshadow 
What I use: NYX "Love in Paris" palette
Brush : E32 http://www.blankcanvascosmetics.com/products/e32-33-double-ended-tapered-crease-blender-smudger.html

Step 3 Apply medium brown to eyelid
What I use: NYX "Love in Paris" palette
Brush : E33 http://www.blankcanvascosmetics.com/products/e32-33-double-ended-tapered-crease-blender-smudger.html

Step 4 Apply black to lash line 
What I use: NYX "Love in Paris" palette
Brush : E27 http://www.blankcanvascosmetics.com/products/e27-cute-mini-detailer.html

Step 5 Lashes  Curl eyelashes and apply mascara
What I use: Maybelline The Rocket Mascara
